prose: TechCrunch reports that Outmarket, founded in late 2023 by former Ethos product lead Vishal Sankhla (ex-Facebook, ex-Uber), raised a $34.5 million Series B at a reported $335 million valuation. Outmarket uses AI to automate paperwork for insurance agencies and brokers, focusing on commercial insurance, where policies require deep customization; Sankhla notes 95% of insurance is still sold through human agents through highly manual processes.
highlights: Outmarket raises $34.5M Series B at a reported $335M valuation
AI automation for insurance agency and broker paperwork
Focus: commercial insurance (general liability, workers' comp, D&O)
Sankhla: 95% of insurance still sold via human agents, mostly manual
